no_project: Open a project to see its gear matches.
title: Gear match
lead: The gears-matcher service reads the project's specifications and says, per requirement, which gears of the catalogue cover it, with its evidence. Nothing goes into the product until you add it.
paths_hint: Paths of the project's documents, comma-separated (docs/…, upload:…). Empty: its PRDs.
unavailable: Gear matches are not available here: {reason}
none_body: A match takes a few minutes and a few dozen model calls. Its result varies between runs: every run is kept, and two can be compared.
hint_not_a_template: What to do: the documents read are not in the Constructor Fabric spec format (requirements with cpt- ids), and this deployment does not let the matcher read free-form ones. Name documents in that format under "Documents to read" (for example docs/prd/…), or ask the deployment's administrator to allow free-form reading.
hint_unreachable: What to do: the gears-matcher service did not answer. Run again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, Organization › Gears matcher shows whether the service is set up.
hint_unauthorized: What to do: the gears-matcher service refused Studio's secret. The deployment's administrator sets STUDIO_GEARS_MATCHER_SECRET to the service's secret.
action_create_gear: Nothing covers it: create a gear
action_proposed_in_product: Its gear is in the product
action_proposed_not_pickable: Its proposed gears are not in the catalogue the product reads
no_passage: The passage was not found in the text sent (read by the matcher's free-form reading).
not_in_catalogue: Not in the catalogue the product reads
question: What the matcher could not decide
answer_label: Your answer: what the requirement means here, so the next match can decide
answer_saved: Saved. The next match reads it beside the requirement.
compare_none: No earlier run with a report.
grid_empty_note: The matcher found no requirement in the documents it read.
grid_no_matches: Nothing matches this search or filter.
gear_empty_title: No gear named in this run
gear_empty_note: The matcher named no candidate gear for any requirement.
